props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: Whether to automatically change the active tab on arrow key focus. Otherwise, tabs will be activated using <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> key press.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the Tab.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the Tab is disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: placement
props.description: Side of the panels the tab list sits on. `left` and `right` also make the tabs vertical (arrow up / down) unless `orientation` is set.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The component orientation (layout flow direction).
